/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/mshhd-mein-mslman-ne-hie-zlm-ye-dhaia-hai.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p])
new = pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()
before, roman_and_body = new.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, body = roman_and_body.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
assert before + b'---\\n' + body == old
source = body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
transcript = roman.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(source) == len(transcript) == 7
for i, (s, r) in enumerate(zip(source, transcript), 1):
    assert len(s.splitlines()) == len(r.splitlines())
    assert r.splitlines()[0].strip() == str(i)
assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in roman.decode())
print(sum(len(s.splitlines()) - 1 for s in source), 'verses across', len(source), 'stanzas. Original bytes preserved.')
PY"
